name: ObsessionDB
long_description: ObsessionDB is a real-time data warehouse that makes your data stack agent-ready. Your agents can ingest and query vast amounts of data in seconds, without the scary infra bill. Powered by our own more efficient fork of ClickHouse®.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Co-Founder & CEO at ObsessionDB. Bootstrapped our previous company to $1.5 M ARR and ran it profitably for 4 years, serving 5 billion real-time API requests per month. We ran data workloads at petabyte scale. Previously worked with the data team at enterprises like Wendy's, Victoria's Secret, FOX, Disney, Axel Springer, and Groupon.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder at ObsessionDB. Serial founder with 4 companies, including Frens (acquired by Swyke) and Laserfocus (YC W20). Previously CTO at Numia building real-time blockchain data infrastructure. Founded Gambify in 2014, soccer app scaled to 6 figure players with support from German National Team. Engineering Manager at Localytics. MS in Data Science from KTH Stockholm, MS in Cloud Computing from TU Berlin.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Co-Founder at ObsessionDB (YC F26). Previously co-founded Numia, scaling blockchain infrastructure to serve billions of monthly requests across 100+ blockchains. Co-founded and CTO at Frens (acquired by Swyke), autonomous infra validating 70+ blockchains. Co-founded and CTO at Lokalportal, led a team of 25. Degree in chemistry and economics. For a year spent a few mornings a week in a highschool chemistry lab to blow up things with students.
